rationale: With only 4 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced liquidation at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a name with a 42.5 bps spread and recent sharp downward momentum in the last two candles (dropping from ~$128.25 to ~$127.54). The risk/reward is unfavorable given the wide spread, the short time horizon, and the already-realized daily loss — there is no mechanical edge sufficient to justify entry this close to the bell.
